edges_list.rationale: Vous utiliserez des outils tels que Terraform pour développer et déployer des applications à grande échelle.
Terraform is an infrastructure as code tool used in cloud computing, particularly with Azure.
The job requires expertise in solutions cloud on both AWS and Azure.
Node.js is often used as a runtime environment for Python projects, especially in data engineering.
Terraform is widely used with Azure Cloud for infrastructure provisioning and management.
Azure DevOps integrates with Terraform to streamline infrastructure provisioning and deployment.
